subject: Request: Full residency sweep & confirmation — Stellarus
messages:
From: Martin O'Neal <legal@stellar-us.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Stellarus Ops <ops@stellarus.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: Full residency sweep & confirmation — Stellarus

Priya,

Per our contract we are requesting a full erase of all prompt inputs, model outputs, and related inference logs tied to our tenant (tenant_id: stell-9482). Scope: US and EU regions (where applicable), production and staging clusters, and any cached KV state. We need the following: 

- A written runbook of the purge steps and timeline
- A manifest showing files removed and locations (object keys/paths)
- Audit-proof evidence (signed attestation or DocuSign) that data was purged as requested

Target window: as soon as possible — ideally complete by 2026-09-24 EOD PT. Please advise if Redwood needs any additional confirmation from our side. I've attached the formal request PDF.

Thanks,
Martin O'Neal
General Counsel, Stellarus
Attachment: stellarus-deletion-request.pdf

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Martin O'Neal <legal@stellar-us.com>
Cc: Stellarus Ops <ops@stellarus.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full residency sweep & confirmation — Stellarus

Martin — thanks for the clear scope and the PDF. We're able to execute this sweep under our standard deletion playbook but will surface a short mutual action plan to confirm exact objects and timing before execution. Immediate next steps: 

1) Confirmation of tenant_id: please confirm stell-9482 is correct for both production and staging.
2) I'll loop in ops and security (cc'd) to prepare the runbook and the sterilization manifest.
3) Proposed execution window: 2026-09-23 18:00 - 22:00 PT (to minimize production impact). If that doesn't work, we can move to 2026-09-24 daytime window.
4) We'll produce a signed attestation (DocuSign) and a CSV manifest listing removed object keys and timestamps.

Please reply with "Confirm" to authorize Redwood to proceed with the proposed window, or suggest an alternate time.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — production & customer ops

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Martin O'Neal <legal@stellar-us.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stellarus Ops <ops@stellarus.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Full residency sweep & confirmation — Stellarus

Thanks Priya — ops update and execution checklist below. I'll own the sweep and provide the manifest once complete. High-level runbook (abbreviated):

- Prepare ticket: REDWOOD-OPS-18492 (created)
- Freeze write access to tenant stell-9482 for the window (2026-09-23 18:00 PT)
- Stop inference workers for tenant: graceful drain, flush KV caches
- Delete prompt logs from object store (s3://redwood-prod/stell-9482/prompt-logs/*) and archives (s3://redwood-archive/stell-9482/). Commands executed are logged and checksummed.
- Purge model outputs and derivations from ephemeral stores and long-term stores (ensuring we respect retention exceptions)
- Remove indexing artifacts (search indexes, embeddings) tied to tenant keys
- Rotate and redact any remaining pointers in observability traces (trace IDs will be replaced with a redaction token)
- Generate sterilization_manifest_20260923.csv with: object_key, location, deleted_at, operator, checksum-proof-id
- Create signed attestation (DocuSign) and provide a CSV + proof bundle to Stellarus contact

Estimated wall time for execution: 45-120 minutes (dependent on archive data size). We'll keep a live ops note in the shared Drive folder for real-time visibility: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C

Attachments (to be delivered post-exec): sterilization_manifest_20260923.csv; internal ops log (redaction-only bundle).

If Stellarus wants a dry-run/preview of the manifest layout before execution, say the word and we'll share a schema snapshot.

—Karthik
Lead, Site Reliability — Redwood Inference
Attachment stub: sterilization_manifest_20260923.csv

From: Martin O'Neal <legal@stellar-us.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Stellarus Ops <ops@stellarus.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full residency sweep & confirmation — Stellarus

Confirm. Stell-9482 (prod & staging) authorized for 2026-09-23 18:00 PT execution. We authorize Redwood to proceed under the scope described.

Thank you for the attention to the audit trail — once you post the DocuSign attestation and sterilization manifest, we'll countersign and close our internal ticket.

Martin O'Neal
General Counsel, Stellarus
Attachment: docusign-stellarus-erase.pdf
